verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a design platform under an open-source license is a fair question for a design tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Spline's 'Self-Hosted' export, which packages a single project and its runtime as a ZIP. That is an adjacent export feature, not self-hosting the editor platform. The docs also say files live in Spline's cloud, and nothing mentions an open-source license or a deployable server.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
